messages:
meera: Heads-up — I'm taking oncall for tonight (18:00-06:00 UTC). Quick plan: squelch noisy non-prod batch alerts, bump `batch-gpu-alert` CPU threshold from 70% -> 85% for window 18:15-06:00, and route batch timeouts (alertpolicy: batch-timeout) to #eng-sre-staging instead of #eng-oncall while we run infra tests. Will revert tomorrow 09:00 unless someone objects.

sanjay: quick q — can you paste the alertpolicy id and runbook? I want to avoid weird side effects on prod routing.

meera: alert id: policy-batch-2024 (ap-77b3). Runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/batch-timeouts. Also applying a temporary route override in our alertmanager config, will push PR in a min.

alex: ack. FYI if you're changing threshold be careful with the autoscaler SLO alerts — those tie to the same metric. Suggest updating only the `k8s.batch` group thresholds, not the global cpu_alerts.

meera: good call. I'll scope to `k8s.batch` and add a comment. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4321 — patch below

```yaml
route:
  receiver: eng-sre-staging
  match:
    team: batch
    env: staging
repeat_interval: 24h
routes:
  - match_re:
      alertname: 'batch-timeout|batch-job-failed'
    receiver: eng-sre-staging
    continue: false
  - match:
      alertname: 'batch-gpu-cpu'
    annotations:
      note: 'temp threshold raised for nightly tests'
    receiver: eng-oncall

# threshold change handled in alert rules: cpu > 85%
```

ops-bot: Deploy triggered by meera: infra/alerting PR #4321 — staging routing + thresholds.

dave: :eyes: I'm on the 22:00-02:00 overlap with you, meera. If anything unexpected pops up ping me @dave and I'll jump in.

sanjay: LGTM but please add a comment in the PR mentioning rollback time and owner (meera). Also add an entry in the handoff note: https://redwood-internal/oncall/handbook/shift-notes

meera: done — PR updated with rollback 09:00 and owner tag. Added a short handoff note in the doc. I'll monitor for the first 30m after change and post a summary.

alex: thanks. One more: can we mute the noisy test alerts instead of changing thresholds long-term? create a temporary silence in PD and annotate.

meera: will create PD silence for those test alert IDs for 8h. PD silence id: silence-7845. Adding to the PR and runbook.

dave: :thumbsup:
